text: Revenue went up by 700 BRL between 2017-09 and 2017-10. The largest contribution came from SP (400 BRL). The second largest contribution came from RJ (300 BRL). Revenue is defined as: Total payments received for delivered orders The logged rule for this change is late_delivery.
